issues.message: Our copy of the VAT Decree-Law predates Federal Decree-Law No. 16 of 2025 (in force 1 Jan 2026), which changed Art. 48 and 74 and repealed Art. 79 (bis). The current consolidated text has not been collected.
Art. 54 (bis) (added by DL 16/2025) is not in our copy.

Deregistration deadline conflict: ER Art. 14(1) says 20 business days; the FTA deregistration service page (updated 24 Sep 2026) says 30. No deadline may be stated until a qualified reviewer resolves it.
